nom: La Roche-Posay Effaclar Adapalene Gel 0.1% Topical Retinoid Acne Treatment

avis.texte: I love this product. Does it work - yes. I have combo skin, severe eczema and hormonal acne flares around my smile lines and cheeks. This doesnt help with my flare ups, but has had a great impact on preventing cystic acne on my cheeks and forehead. I have noticed my dark spots lighten quite a bit. I use this product 5x a week. I got it 6 months ago and still have a months worth of product left. I do wish it was less expensive, but the price will not deter me from repurchasing.

One tube takes forever to go through. I only use a pea sized amount. After the purging was done, I rarely had any more cystic pimples. I bought this around the same time a year ago and the price has almost doubled. That's kinda crazy

I really wanted to give this product a try after reading reviews but my skin does not like it at all. Two day afrer using it, my skin becomes dry, irritated, and it burns. I have tried it three times (once per week) and i just can't keep up with it. My skin just straight up hurts. I've never had anything cause my skin to react this way. I wont be continuing to use it unfortunately :(
My forehead is very textured so i thoight it would help but instead i broke out really bad :/

avis.titre: you will molt like a snake (in a good way)
avis.texte: i know it says specifically not to use it as a spot treatment and to apply a thin layer to the whole face, but my god does the skin just slough off your face. i have to just use it on the parts of my face with acne, because if i go anywhere NEAR my eyes it wrecks my whole shop. burning, flaking, redness that makes me look like i need an exorcism. once i'm done molting, though, my skin looks better than it has in years.

Ive struggled with cystic acne for years but was scared to try this because i've heard awful things about the purge period. Im SO glad i gave it a try. To avoid the purge i started really slow (every 3 nights for 2 weeks, then every 2 nights for a week, and then finally every night). I also stopped using all other actives and used the La Roche Posay Toleriane cleanser and double repair moisturizer. I also slept with a humidifer to try to keep my skin as moisturized as possible since this can definitely dry it out. It started to clear up my skin so quickly! The breakouts i did have healed much faster and my scarring faded fast. A must have for acne prone skin!!

I was a little skeptical about it at first. But after just five months my acne was almost all clear. It evened my skin tone, and flattened the texture of skin I had. I did break out a lot, but that was super normal for starting a product like this. My skin is now clear!

Probably worked on different people but didn't work on me I've been using it for 1-2 weeks til now and I was hoping this would calm my acne but made it all worse and made my skin get more pimples than usual.
My dermatologist recommended this as an alternative to Trentinoin. I feel that it works just as well and I love this brand of skin care.

avis.titre: I would not buy this again.
avis.texte: I got this to potentially help with some mild breakouts from having oily skin. And also to clear up some of my rosacea. Wellll don't get this. I used it for 3 days and now if I wash my skin, put any of my makeup on or even my normal face moisturizer, my skin burns. I've discontinued use. But now I'm wondering how long it will be before my face is back to normal.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really liked this serum. It is unscented which I really liked, as I think scented serum, unless it's like a fruit serum, don't really work. It also worked really well in removing my blemishes and preventing more blackheads from forming on my nose. I also really liked how easy it was to squeeze product out of the tube into a good size.

Ever since I switched my face wash, my skin has been breaking out uncontrollably so bad! avis.titre: Hi unfortunately I don't have a lot of nice things to say
avis.texte: I have been struggling with acne for a long time and this product from a brand a really respect seems to be my solution and it wasn't now i got a burn red face and my acne still there … within a week of use following every rule on the box and nor being alergic to any ingredient i get my face burn and dried even when im using your cleanser for sensitive skin too … i hope this works on other people

I been using this for two years now and it really does make a difference in my skin. This is great for when I need to maintain hormonal acne or clearing up acne scars. I have combination, sensitive skin and this is the product that I will always reach for at night to clear up acne/scars & to improve overall complexion.

I introduced this almost a year ago and I have been using it since every other night or so. I find that using it every night dries my skin. You have to introduce it slowly and give time to your skin to adjust. My dermatologist approved. It keeps acne at bay and stimulates collagen production, which we could all use more of. Consistency is key and don't forget to use sunscreen during the day (which you should do regardless).

I have used the same main ingredient before from cheaper brands and the irritation at the same % was always too much. The supporting ingredients in here do not irritate or dry out my skin. Worth every penny. It glides across the skin so you can get a pea sized amount to actually spread across your face.

i've used this for about 2 weeks now and so far i really like it. my skin definitely went through a purge period but now my pores have shrunk so much and my skin is so smooth, a little dry but i just use a thick cream afterwards

I have dry sensitive skin If you have acne scars, you're familiar with the uneven texture on the areas of your skin where the scars are. Your pores are almost like craters. Before this product, I used La Roche Posay's Retinol B3 Serum @ night, it was a good introduction to this product which is much stronger acting. You do not need a lot of this. The texture of my skin is so EVEN and TIGHT (in a good way) I have used it for a week now, I think I was using too much of it becaude my skin did dry out slightly but wow. This is PERFECT for acne scars

I love this stuff. Truly got rid of some seriously stubborn acne. Ive noticed a total change to my skin texture as well. My skin literally looks so good. A pea size is perfect for the whole face. You need such a thin layer. I pair with a pretty rich moisturizer as well. Make sure its totally dry though before layering product!! I did experience some sensitivity and burning at first when figuring out what worked best. Truly give it 1-3 months of consistent use and you will see a difference!

avis.titre: Great product just have to test it out first
avis.texte: Hello beautiful people. I came across this topical because my dermatologist recommended it to me. However, at first I inly applied it after just cleansing my face. I did notice that my pimples dried out but also my skin around the pimple. Now, that I have a more packed skincare regimen I use it every night after all my routine. I can guarantee your face wont dry out if you include it in a routine where other products will be involved. If you really desire to dry a pimple fast and overnight, I would recommend it to use it alone. However, if you wanna decrease pores size and prevent pimples use a little and create a thing layer in the areas where you tend to breakout. I hope this advise helps :)

I have been using this for a couple years and it does work when you use it consistently. I still get small break outs, but usually nothing too bad when I use this product. I am still am trying to find the right regimen to completely clear my skin because there are many facotrs that can contribute to acne. I do notice that when I put this on small breakouts even on my body, it calms it down really fast. I think it takes some time to show results, but it is a good product. I always would recommend using at night and moisturizing because it may dry out your skin at first.

I have been useing this for at least 4-5 months now and it has made my skin incredibly dry and irritated every time. I only use about once a week and have tried eveything but just continues to irritate me horribly. Its takes the entire week before my skin returns back to normal. I wanted to be able to up the usage to at least twice a week but just cant. I will say it does clear my acne a bit but too iritating for me

avis.titre: When used right, an absolute gem
avis.texte: I've been using this for about 2-3 years now. With starting slowly and gradually increasing use, I've hadno side effects besides a ~little~ dryness that's easily fixed with a good moisturizer. I used to have regular breakouts, but this cleared it up so quickly. The only occasional breakout I get now are extremely mild and all go away much quicker than before. My skin's texture is also far improved. So many of my acne scars have lightened or disappeared. All this to say, if you are careful with using this (ie using a pea size for your entire face, diligent sunscreen, good moisturizer, and starting slow with use and gradually increasing to your comfort), it's absolutely worth a purchase

I've been using this for about a month, and it's already helped a little with fine lines, and my acnr scars. It hasn't been too tough on my skin at all either. 100% recommend, however it's not for first time retinoid users.

This gel is unscented and applies smoothly. The product itself feels a little silicone. It does not clog my pores, however i did experience some dryness and it took my skin a while to adjust. after the purging period, my skin looks amazing! It cleared up all my black heads and texture and minimized my other breakouts. My dermatologist said she could even tell that i used a retinol and said that i have very nice skin
ive been struggling with acne forever and i used this and it worked so fast!! my acne cleared up and i have none pls get it!

avis.titre: As good, maybe even better, than prescription
avis.texte: I've used both prescription and non-prescription, and this one is by far the best. I use it mostly on the T zone and a tiny bit goes a long way.

avis.titre: Do your research before using this product!!
avis.texte: I had to go through a lot of trial and error while using this product because i was unfamiliar with retinol. I think companies that sell these kinds of products where you're not able to mix certain things together SHOULD BE ON LABEL. I burned my skin many times because i was using the incorrect face wash and moisturizer with it. Granted it does help with acne in my case but its really harsh on your skin. Im still only 2 weeks in and it says you should use for 3 months before you see the full results so thats what i will do. I paired this with the cerave hydrating face wash and moisturing cream and that seems to work fine with it. Theres no way around using some sort of moisturizer because of how DRY and flakey your skin will get. Im a little surprised this isnt a prescription type of medication for skin because this can be intense. Anyway, dont make the same mistakes i did and fully research on this product and figure out what other products and ingredients you can use with it to not irritate your skin!!!

Effaclar Adapalene Gel 0.1% is a game-changer for acne-prone skin. Its topical retinoid formula swiftly targets stubborn blemishes, delivering visible results. With consistent use, pores minimize, and skin texture improves. While initial dryness may occur, it fades as skin adjusts. Overall, an effective ally in the battle against acne, offering clearer, smoother skin.

avis.titre: worth it aslong as you use it right!
avis.texte: i randomly broke out a few months ago and could barely even look at my face, because i had clear skin basically all my life and was so confused. i got this product after seeing dermatologist's reccomend it and i have not lived to regret it. make sure if you're using it to do the sandwich method and make sure while you use it, youre not using it with any serums that dont go well with it, and of course if youre skin is sensitive, start slow! 🤍🤍

I bought an acne cream and their products hurt me. My face is all red. It burns a lot. It seems like my face is burned. Tomorrow I will have to go to the doctor because of everything that happened to me. Even my neck is irritated.

avis.titre: Good product but a little goes a long way
avis.texte: I will say that this product does really good at taking away acne. I used 1 tube of this and i do like this product however it was not good for my skin type. I have very very dry and sensitive skin. In the colder months my face looks like lizard scales. When i first used this product i would do the retinol sandwhich but it would still dry my skin out. I think if you have more oily or combo skin this product will be better for you. My acne type consisted of white heads and the bumps under that took forever to surface and when they did surface they would turn into scabs. A gentler product that I switched too and absolutely love is the First Aid Beauty 0.3% Retinol Complex Serum with Peptides. It has not tried my skin out at all and my face has never been more acne cleared.

I had really bad acne when I started using this product. After a few uses, my skin started to feel tender and it was flaky, it felt like it burned. I googled those symptoms after using adapalene, and according to the website I was reading at those symptoms are normal before your skin is completely used to the product. I trusted the process, and I kept using it every night. After a few weeks, I started to see bigggg results, after 3 months using it, maybe less, my face was acne free, not even during my period I had pimples. So, I decided to stop using it and change my night routine to a different serum, I think it was the glycolic acid, worse thing I've ever done, I started to break out again, then I tried to solve the problem using salicylic acid based products, including the 5% salicylic acid serum, nothing worked until I bought the adapalene again, after a few months, no more acne!!! I lovedddd this product. I've used I think like 4 o 5 bottles. If you have acne this is definitely a must have.

I turned 30 and with it came a bunch of hormonal skin issues (acne, dry skin, scarring from acne, fine lines). I knew I needed to start on a retinol and heard about this retinoid gel and how effective it is. I waited over a year to try it though because I was so scared of the purging process and I tried everything else to get my skin clear again. Nothing worked of course so I resorted to this. I started applying it once a week for about 6 weeks. The first few weeks my skin would get really dry and I purged a little, but nothing that wouldn't go away on its own before it was time for the next application. After week 3 or so I noticed how glowy my skin would be the morning after applying the gel. Weeks 4-6 the glow started lingering for a few days. It was working! After 6 weeks I started applying it twice a week. It was a little irritated but only for the first week of doing that and it got better. At week 9 I implemented an exfoliating night (FAB radiance pads)- the first time exfoliating my skin in almost a year. I saw a girl on instagram do this the night before applying retinol and boy was my skin happy after that routine. Now here we are 4 months later and I am applying the gel 3 nights a week, exfoliating 1 night a week, and resting the other 3 nights a week. A complete skin cycle routine that I thought I would never be able to do! I can't wait to give it more time and see what my skin can do with this product! :)

Please trust me this stuff works when you apply it to your face correctly. I wash with the toleriane hydrating cleanser then I apply the toleriane matt face lotion. Last I appy this Gel. I have no irritations. My acne has cleared up in days!! My skin is not dry because I apply lotion first. I recommend you follow the budget dermatologist on YouTube.

I've been using a retinol from a different brand for over a year and switched to this. I used it two nights in a row and haven't used it for 3 days now - it caused my skin to feel like it was burning and made my face and neck red, dry, and itchy. Feels and looks like a sunburn. If I don't touch my face for 4ish hours it goes away but even water causes it to flare up again.

Its effective on my skin, just follow the directions on applying it and use it consistently. I have been using this for more than 1 year now together with the effaclar facial wash and the toleriane moisturizer

avis.titre: Not for extra sensitive eyes haha

ive been using this for around 5 months and i still get the occasional pimple, which it a huge improvement from before. be prepared to wait several months to see results, but its so worth. start slow (2-3x a week) and put over moisturizing cream.

I've been using This for a week now. I dont have much acne but I noticed less blackheads have gone away and my skin feels smoother and looks healthier. Just using it 2x a week right now. Definitely will buy another one.

I added this to my routine as my intro to retinol having never used a retinol product previously. I definitely noticed it helped with my skin texture, but it didn't really go beyond that. Perhaps it's due to it being such a low % and more of a beginner retinol? I used almost the entire tube over the course of a month, using every evening. My skin was smoother, but not much clearer, and I didn't notice an improvement of my acne scarring. Won't be buying again, unfortunately.

avis.titre: Be cautious if you have sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I've been using La Riche Posay products for years, such as their acne cleansers and toners. I've never had any severe reactions with any of their products until I used this gel. I tried this stuff two days ago and now my entire face is severely flakey, red, dry, and painful. It feels and looks like I have a sun burn (I had no sun exposure). Even trying to put moisturizer or Aloe vera gel on my skin, it stings and makes my skin inflamed. I've only put a small dab of this gel on my face twice and got this terrible reaction. I've never had this reaction to any other product. I'm very disheartened because this gel did seem to help shrink pimples but, it literally ruined my face. Be very cautious when using this gel if you have sensitive skin.
With consistent use, makes your skin smooth and glowy. I'm a physician and all my derm friends recommend this as a daily retinol. I get a lot of compliments on my skin now (used to be acne prone)

I don't get much acne nowadays, but when I used this on my face for the first time I noticed I broke out. It wasn't a severe breakout, but it was still a little inconvenient. My husband, however loved this product! Just because it wasn't for me, doesn't mean it's not for anyone else!

So, my dermatologist had just prescribed me an adapalene gel and no pharmacy had it. I came home to this package and this adapalene gel was I there which was a life saver. I actually like this. I didn't have any issues while using this product. A little goes a long way. I already ordered more.
I do hot yoga and sweat a lot. This gel is great. It really helped with my acne. I will be purchasing more once I run out.

I feel this was a good product to use after the face wash, and although it does work well, it will dry out your skin so be sure to apply lotion after some time.
This really helped clear up the little impurities on my skin like sun spots and helped fade old acne scars. I also noticed it didn't clog my pores which was a major plus.

I'm on my second tube of this because I love it so much—I did break out a little to begin with because I was using it once a day from the very start but once my skin got used to it I feel like it did wonders. I dont usually leave reviews but this product is literally amazing. it IMMEDIATELY cleared a set of cystic pimples that i almost gave up on treating because i thought nothing else was going to work, but this paired with the mad hippie blemish cream works SO WELL

if you struggle with acne flare ups or just acne in general, this is for you. I love this product is changed my skin. When I first used it my skin started to purge and peel which is completely normal for a retinod. After that stage my skin completely cleared up. Using this product took time but it was worth it.

avis.titre: La Roche Posay, I love you
avis.texte: At this point I own most of the La roche posay line and for good reason. This brand is trusted, delivers results and has a competitive price. If I only owned one product by the brand- it would be this. Since starting adapalene a month ago, I've already noticed an extreme change to the texture of my skin. (My skin has always been textured with small bumps and has sun damage). My skin feels so much smoother and my breakouts are smaller. I can't wait to see the difference after a few more months. Holy grail!

avis.titre: BE PATIENT TO SEE RESULTS!! TOTALLY WORTH IT!
avis.texte: The product might be harsh on your skin when you first start. I had redness, slight burning, and really really dry skin when I started. Trust the process and start slow since your skin is going to purge before it gets better. Have a consistent routine where you start with a few days a week and then build up. Use a heavy duty moisturizer and SUNSCREEN!!!!! You will definitely see results after a new weeks/months of consistent use depending on your skin's condition! Don't be afraid and just have patience :)

I have been using the Adapalene + the duo cream for 8 weeks and I cannot say enough about it. I was hesitant because like many I have very very sensitive skin. What worked for me may not work for another but how I handled the transition to avoid dry irritated skin was an oil from Tuel "detox" - I would wash then apply about 3-5 drops of the oil ( the oil is for acne skin so it will not clog or congest your skin at all ) I let it sit for about 5mins then apply a little less than a pea size of the Adapalene gel. The duo cream I used during the day very small amount spread over my entire face, to help with drying as I said before the oil I used is from Tuel "Rehab". Yes two different oils are used one for day one for night. The duo cream dried out my active acne ( I am cystic acne prone. Big nasty pimples that were nickle size or better on my face) and the Adapalene gel handled the black heads and the turn over of the dead skin on my face. As of today I am cystic acne free for the most part and I'm currently just waiting on the hyperpigmentation to subside, skin is pretty clear. Thank you LRP team for these amazing products.

This retinol is pretty low frills. The formula is good and spreads easily - it is a gel like texture. I did have a purging period when I started using this product, which is normal. I also experience some dryness/peeling which is not abnormal. Although I do not have acne prone skin, this retinol has cleared my blackheads and occasional white heads. My skin also looks brighter and more even
The first thing i noticed after using this product is the dramatic change in skin texture. It has made my skin smoother. Also, it has helped clear up some acne. However, my skin is quick to burn.
This product was recommended to me by my dermatologist to correct wrinkles. It works very well.

I've only been using it for 3 days, and it's really been wonderful. And my face has improved too much.

After trying both differin gel and La Roche Posay efficalar, I can definitely say that La Roche Posay takes the cake. Both adapalene products caused an adjustment period (purging/dryness), however LRP redndered MUCH better reaults in terms of skin smoothness, texture and overall glow. I also noticed a substantial diminish in my hyperpigmentation. LRP adapalene gel continues to be a staple for me. Will definitely repurchase!

I used this for years on my moderate acne. When I started, I would have probably 20 small spots and 5-10 big spots on my face at a time. After 6 months of use, my acne was reduced to 3 or 4 small spots once a month from hormones and sugar. It reduced the severity and longevity of those hormonal pimples. Blackheads were also reduced. I bought this product because I have acne scars that kind of just popped up one day, and I couldn't for the life of me figure out where they came from, as I have clear skin. So I decided to try this brand because of how much dermatologists praise it. I did some research and I ended up with the Effaclar medicated cleansing gel with salicylic acid, the clarifying solution, the duo cream, and I bought the Toleriane dual action moisturizer. Fast forward about 3 months and I could not get the scars to go away. So I tried the adapalene gel, and I was using it religiously for a few months, and while that product along with the product line I bought was making my skin look amazing, it was irritating the scars that I have. It turns out they are scars from using the apricot scrub from St. Ives. They are tear marks from the scrub. So I'm afraid to use it like a retinol, because my skin is sensitive to those products now. So yes, it has kept my skin looking great in the spots I use it on that aren't in the scar range, but I would consult with a dermatologist first to see if they recommend it for you in general, but especially for acne scars and how it can benefit your skin like a retinol.
